verses.text: For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. Of David. Hear my cry, O God; attend to my prayer.

xrefs.text: Be anxious for nothing, but in everything, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present your requests to God.
For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. A Psalm of David. Answer me when I call, O God of my righteousness! You have relieved my distress; show me grace and hear my prayer.
Hear my prayer, O LORD, and attend to my plea for mercy.
O Lord, hear my voice; let Your ears be attentive to my plea for mercy.
For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. A Maskil of David. Listen to my prayer, O God, and do not ignore my plea.

verses.text: From the ends of the earth I call out to You whenever my heart is faint. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.

xrefs.text: The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer. My God is my rock, in whom I take refuge, my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold.
If I rise on the wings of the dawn, if I settle by the farthest sea,
Each will be like a shelter from the wind, a refuge from the storm, like streams of water in a dry land, like the shadow of a great rock in an arid land.
He alone is my rock and my salvation; He is my fortress; I will not be shaken.
But if from there you will seek the LORD your God, you will find Him if you seek Him with all your heart and with all your soul.

verses.text: For You have been my refuge, a tower of strength against the enemy.

xrefs.text: The name of the LORD is a strong tower; the righteous run to it and are safe.
My salvation and my honor rest on God, my strong rock; my refuge is in God.
O GOD the Lord, the strength of my salvation, You shield my head in the day of battle.
Because He has inclined His ear to me, I will call on Him as long as I live.
The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer. My God is my rock, in whom I take refuge, my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold.

verses.text: Let me dwell in Your tent forever and take refuge in the shelter of Your wings. Selah

xrefs.text: Surely goodness and mercy will follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the house of the LORD forever.
One thing I have asked of the LORD; this is what I desire: to dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to gaze on the beauty of the LORD and seek Him in His temple.
Keep me as the apple of Your eye; hide me in the shadow of Your wings
He will cover you with His feathers; under His wings you will find refuge; His faithfulness is a shield and rampart.
May the LORD repay your work, and may you receive a rich reward from the LORD, the God of Israel, under whose wings you have taken refuge.”

verses.text: For You have heard my vows, O God; You have given me the inheritance reserved for those who fear Your name.

xrefs.text: Your vows are upon me, O God; I will render thank offerings to You.

At that time those who feared the LORD spoke with one another, and the LORD listened and heard them. So a scroll of remembrance was written before Him regarding those who feared the LORD and honored His name.
He will bless those who fear the LORD— small and great alike.
Teach me Your way, O LORD, that I may walk in Your truth. Give me an undivided heart, that I may fear Your name.
The LORD is my chosen portion and my cup; You have made my lot secure.

verses.text: Increase the days of the king’s life; may his years span many generations.

xrefs.text: He asked You for life, and You granted it— length of days, forever and ever.
his offspring shall endure forever, and his throne before Me like the sun,
For You grant him blessings forever; You cheer him with joy in Your presence.

Yet it was the LORD’s will to crush Him and to cause Him to suffer; and when His soul is made a guilt offering, He will see His offspring, He will prolong His days, and the good pleasure of the LORD will prosper in His hand.
Long may he live! May gold from Sheba be given him. May people ever pray for him; may they bless him all day long.

verses.text: May he sit enthroned in God’s presence forever; appoint Your loving devotion and Your faithfulness to guard him.

xrefs.text: O LORD, do not withhold Your mercy from me; Your loving devotion and faithfulness will always guard me.

saying, “Blessed be the LORD, the God of my master Abraham, who has not withheld His kindness and faithfulness from my master. As for me, the LORD has led me on the journey to the house of my master’s relatives.”
and He will reign over the house of Jacob forever. His kingdom will never end!
In my integrity You uphold me and set me in Your presence forever.
He reaches down from heaven and saves me; He rebukes those who trample me. Selah God sends forth His loving devotion and His truth.

verses.text: Then I will ever sing praise to Your name and fulfill my vows day by day.

xrefs.text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. A song. Praise awaits You, O God, in Zion; to You our vows will be fulfilled.
A Psalm of praise. Of David. I will exalt You, my God and King; I will bless Your name forever and ever.
Then we Your people, the sheep of Your pasture, will thank You forever; from generation to generation we will declare Your praise.
So I will praise You with the harp for Your faithfulness, O my God; I will sing praise to You with the lyre, O Holy One of Israel.
I will enter Your house with burnt offerings; I will fulfill my vows to You—
